name: DeKalb County, IN
findings: DeKalb County has 136 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, DeKalb County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in DeKalb County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through religious groups? Where else does that happen?
